history.summary: UNCONFIRMED IDENTITY - clearly-flagged placeholder; do not publish as a verified temple. No temple named 'Shri Manav Mangal Mandir' in Ambala - or anywhere else in Haryana - has any documented web footprint: Justdial's Ambala temple directory, map-listing searches and targeted web searches return no such temple. 'Manav Mangal' is the name of the well-known Manav Mangal Society, which runs schools in Panchkula, Mohali and Chandigarh (established 1993) - not a temple. 'Manav Chowk' is a locality in Ambala City with its own Shiv Mandir and Shri Vishwakarma Mandir, but neither is called Manav Mangal Mandir. The CSV entry may be a transcription error, a conflation with the Manav Chowk area, or a purely local shrine with no published record. Coordinates are the city-centre of Ambala (30.36422, 76.80819) as a rough approximation only - they do NOT locate the temple. Exclude from publication or hold for field verification.
